'''Dominic Rashad McGuire''' (born October 20, 1985) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player who last played for the [[Real Estelí Baloncesto]].

==High school career==
McGuire played high school prep basketball at [[Abraham Lincoln High School (San Diego)|Lincoln High School]] in San Diego.

==College career==
After high school, McGuire subsequently attended the [[University of California, Berkeley]], where he played [[college basketball]] with the  [[California Golden Bears men's basketball|Cal Golden Bears]]. He transferred to [[California State University, Fresno]] to play with the [[Fresno State Bulldogs men's basketball|Fresno State Bulldogs]], after his sophomore year of college, when he was the fourth-leading scorer for the Cal Golden Bears the during the 2004–05 season.<ref>[https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/news/story?id=2041187 McGuire was fourth-leading scorer last season]</ref>

==Professional career==

===Washington Wizards (2007–2010)===
[[File:Dominic McGuire.jpg|thumb|McGuire with the [[2007–08 Washington Wizards season|Washington Wizards]] in November 2008]]
McGuire was selected in the second round (47th overall) of the [[2007 NBA draft]] out of Fresno State by the [[Washington Wizards]]. On August 13, 2007, McGuire signed a 3-year deal with the [[Washington Wizards]].<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.nba.com/wizards/news/mcguire_070813.html | title=Wizards Sign Second-Round Draft Pick Dominic McGuire | work=[[NBA.com]] | date=2007-08-13 | access-date=2010-07-23}}</ref> On April 16, 2008, McGuire got his first start in his NBA career, against the [[Orlando Magic]].

===Sacramento Kings (2010)===
On February 18, 2010, he was traded to the [[Sacramento Kings]] for a protected [[2010 NBA Draft|2010 2nd round draft]] pick.<ref>{{cite web | title=KINGS ACQUIRE CARL LANDRY, JOEY DORSEY AND LARRY HUGHES IN THREE-WAY TRADE WITH HOUSTON AND NEW YORK | work=[[NBA.com]] | url=http://www.nba.com/kings/news/trade_release_february.html | date=2010-02-18 | access-date=2010-02-19}}</ref>

===Charlotte Bobcats (2010–2011)===
On July 22, 2010, he signed with the [[Charlotte Bobcats]].<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.nba.com/bobcats/release_mcguire_signed_100722.html | title=Bobcats Sign Free Agent Forward Dominic McGuire | work=[[NBA.com]] | date=2010-07-22 | access-date=2010-07-23 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101124164811/http://www.nba.com/bobcats/release_mcguire_signed_100722.html | archive-date=2010-11-24 | url-status=dead }}</ref> On February 24, 2011, McGuire was waived by the Bobcats following a trade between the Bobcats and [[Portland Trail Blazers]].<ref>{{cite web | url = http://www.nba.com/bobcats/release_portland_trade_110224.html | title = Cunningham, Przybilla, Marks, 2 First Round Picks Acquired from Portland | work = [[NBA.com]] | date = 2011-02-24 | access-date = 2011-02-25 | url-status = dead | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20110628201955/http://www.nba.com/bobcats/release_portland_trade_110224.html | archive-date = 2011-06-28 }}</ref> However, he was re-signed on March 3, 2011.<ref>{{cite web | url = http://www.nba.com/bobcats/release_mcguire_110303.html | title = Bobcats Re-Sign Dominic McGuire | work = [[NBA.com]] | date = 2011-03-03 | access-date = 2011-03-04 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20110628213609/http://www.nba.com/bobcats/release_mcguire_110303.html | archive-date = 2011-06-28 | url-status = dead }}</ref>

===Golden State Warriors (2011–2012)===
On December 15, 2011, McGuire signed with the [[Golden State Warriors]].<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.nba.com/warriors/news/warriors_sign_dominic_mcguire_121511.html | title=Warriors Sign Free Agent Forward Dominic McGuire | work=[[NBA.com]] | date=2011-12-15 | access-date=2011-12-15}}</ref>

===Toronto Raptors (2012)===
On September 12, 2012, he signed with the [[Toronto Raptors]].<ref>{{cite web | url=http://blog.raptors.com/press-releases/raptors-sign-dominic-mcguire/ | title=Raptors Sign Dominic McGuire | work=[[NBA.com]] | date=2012-09-12 | access-date=2012-09-12 | archive-date=2012-09-17 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120917003533/http://blog.raptors.com/press-releases/raptors-sign-dominic-mcguire/ | url-status=dead }}</ref> He was waived on November 30, 2012, when the team signed [[Mickael Pietrus]].<ref>{{cite web | url=http://blog.raptors.com/press-releases/raptors-sign-free-agent-forward-mickael-pietrus/ | title=Raptors Sign Free-Agent Forward Mickael Pietrus | work=[[NBA.com]] | date=2012-11-30 | access-date=2012-11-30 | archive-date=2012-11-30 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121130200907/http://blog.raptors.com/press-releases/raptors-sign-free-agent-forward-mickael-pietrus/ | url-status=dead }}</ref>

===New Orleans Hornets (2012–2013)===
On December 16, 2012, McGuire signed with the [[New Orleans Hornets]].<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.nba.com/hornets/news/hornets-sign-mcguire | title=HORNETS SIGN MCGUIRE | work=NBA.com | access-date=December 16, 2012}}</ref> He was waived by the Hornets on January 4, 2013.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/hornets/news/hornets-waive-dominic-mcguire|title=HORNETS WAIVE DOMINIC MCGUIRE|work=NBA.com|access-date=January 4, 2012}}</ref>

===Indiana Pacers (2013)===
On January 7, 2013, McGuire signed with the [[Indiana Pacers]] on a 10-day contract.<ref>[http://www.nba.com/pacers/news/pacers-sign-dominic-mcguire Pacers Sign Dominic McGuire]</ref> He was signed to another 10-day contract on January 17, 2013.<ref>[http://www.nba.com/pacers/news/pacers-re-sign-dominic-mcguire Pacers Re-Sign Dominic McGuire]</ref>

===Utah Jazz (2013)===
On September 26, 2013, he signed with the [[Utah Jazz]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/2013/news/09/26/jazz-sign-harris-mcguire-machado.ap/ |title=Jazz round out roster with three camp invites |website=[[NBA.com]] |access-date=2013-09-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131203095824/http://www.nba.com/2013/news/09/26/jazz-sign-harris-mcguire-machado.ap/ |archive-date=2013-12-03 |url-status=dead }}</ref> He was later waived by the Jazz on October 26.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=14657 |title=Utah Jazz waive Brian Cook, Dominic McGuire, Justin Holiday, Lester Hudson and Scott Machado |access-date=2013-10-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141006102942/http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=14657 |archive-date=2014-10-06 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

===Santa Cruz Warriors (2014)===
In January 2014, he was acquired by the [[NBA D-League]]'s [[Santa Cruz Warriors]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/dleague/santacruz/warriors_acquire_mcguire_010414.html Santa Cruz Warriors Acquire Dominic McGuiree]</ref> In March 2014, he was traded to the NBA D-League's [[Tulsa 66ers]].

===Gigantes de Guayana (2014)===
In April 2014, he signed with [[Gigantes de Guayana]] of Venezuela for the rest of the 2014 [[Liga Profesional de Baloncesto|LPB]] season.<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/world/america/117807/gigantes-de-guayana-sign-dominic-mcguire-curtis-withers.html Gigantes de Guayana sign Dominic McGuire, Curtis Withers]</ref>

===Hapoel Eilat (2014)===
On August 27, 2014, he signed to play in Israel with [[Hapoel Eilat B.C.|Hapoel Eilat]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League]].<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/israel/132733/dominic-mcguire-signs-with-hapoel-eilat.html Dominic McGuire signs with Hapoel Eilat]</ref>

===Hapoel Holon (2014–2015)===
On November 6, 2014, he left Eilat and signed with another Israeli club, [[Hapoel Holon]] for the rest of the season.<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/israel/140126/hapoel-holon-signing-dominic-mcguire-parting-ways-with-will-coleman.html Hapoel Holon signing Dominic McGuire, parting ways with Will Coleman]</ref>

===Shenzhen Leopards (2015–2016)===
In August 2015, McGuire signed with the [[Shenzhen Leopards]] of China for the [[2015–16 CBA season]].<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/world/asia/173298/dongguan-leopards-sign-dominic-mcguire.html Dongguan Leopards sign Dominic McGuire]</ref>

===Leones de Ponce (2016)===
On February 26, 2016, he signed with the [[Leones de Ponce (basketball)|Leones de Ponce]] of Puerto Rico for the 2016 [[Baloncesto Superior Nacional|BSN]] season.<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/world/america/192241/leones-de-ponce-announce-dominic-mcguire.html Leones de Ponce announce Dominic McGuire]</ref> On April 14, 2016, he parted ways with Leones de Ponce.<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/world/america/197015/leones-de-ponce-sign-denzel-bowles-to-replace-dominic-mcguire.html Leones de Ponce sign Denzel Bowles to replace Dominic McGuire]</ref>

===Club Malvín (2018)===
On April 19, 2018, McGuire was reported to have signed with [[Club Malvín]] of the [[Liga Uruguaya de Basketball]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Dominic Mcguire llegó este mediodía y jugará mañana ante Defensor Sporting|url=http://www.clubmalvin.uy/webnuevo/dominic-mcguire-llego-este-mediodia-y-jugara-manana-ante-defensor-sporting|language=es|date=April 19, 2018|website=clubmalvin.uy|publisher=Club Malvín|access-date=April 19, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Dominic McGuire signs with Club Malvin|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/america/uruguay/271911/dominic-mcguire-signs-with-club-malvin.html|date=April 19, 2018|website=Sportando.basketball|access-date=April 19, 2018}}{{Dead link|date=February 2024 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

===Aguacateros de Michoacán (2018–present)===
In December 2018, McGuire joined Mexican team [[Aguacateros de Michoacán]] of the [[Liga Nacional de Baloncesto Profesional]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Dominic McGuire regresa a Aguacateros|url=http://www.lavozdemichoacan.com.mx/deportes/dominic-mcguire-regresa-a-aguacateros/|newspaper=La Voz de Michoacán|date=6 December 2018|access-date=11 February 2019|language=es}}</ref>
